summary: Deep Frost Frostbolt build with Fingers of Frost, Shatter and Winter's Chill, plus Arcane Concentration. Its own playstyle, 5% behind Frostfire. The preset is High Order with a Major Spellblasting Potion.
rotation: Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial) on a free GCD
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 90 s left (almost never fires)
Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge: the boss counts as Frozen, so 4 times the damage and Shatter crit
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 41 spell power and 11 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is Season of Discovery's server value, 0.429; Forever's client has 0, as SoD's did
Frostbolt X's base damage ×1.04, half of beta 70291's +8% raise of the low ranks; the client has ×1.00
Frostbolt XI (AQ book) left out: +50 with it
Arcane Focus 5 and Incineration 3 do nothing for this rotation
Raid bosses assumed not freezable; Fingers of Frost charge timing open
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII); with the books Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frost unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge.
